description: Everything about one Cardano token: price (ADA and USD), the change of each of the two prices over 5 m to 7 d (percent; they differ by the move of ADA/USD), 24 h volume and liquidity (ADA), market cap and FDV (USD), supply, holder count, evidence-based fraud flags (open mint authority, concentrated supply, liquidity pulled, creator sold, lookalike, new and thin: each with its evidence and rule), its largest liquidity pools and a safety assessment. Use it to answer price, liquidity or risk questions about a specific token.

unit.description: Token unit: 56-hex policy id followed by the asset name in hex (no separator). Get it from `search` or `list_tokens`.
